We used Sushant for a 6-day tour of the Golden Triangle (New Delhi, Agra, Jaipur). Rajesh, our driver, was fantastic!! We were so well taken care of and everything was incredibly smooth.

We booked our own hotels/flights but Sushant took care of all tickets, tour guides, and logistics. Guides were all English speaking and we liked all of them.

Below is our fast-paced but comprehensive itinerary.

Day 1
Pickup from airport
Overnight in Delhi

Day 2
Full day private tour in Delhi with entrances & guide(s):
Red Fort (Outside View), Raj Ghat, Humayun’s Tomb, India Gate & Parliament House (Drive Past), Lotus Temple, Qutub Minar, Akshardham Temple

Day 3
Travel to Agra in the morning
Half day private tour with entrances and guides in Agra of Agra Fort, Tomb of I'timād-ud-Daulah, and Mehtab Bagh
Note: We went in January so ended up doing Taj Mahal first since it was sunny.

Day 4
Taj Mahal in the morning
Drive to Jaipur & see Fatehpur Sikri and Abhaneri on the way

Day 5
Full Day private tour in Jaipur with entrances & guides: Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Jal Mal (Outside View), Patrika Gate

Day 6
Leave Jaipur by plane.
